description: Maya is hosting a family brunch to celebrate her grandmother's 80th birthday and must make the final call about the food, dessert handling, and afternoon program, with input from four relatives.

shared_context.S1: The family brunch will be held at Maya's home on Saturday for her grandmother's 80th birthday.
shared_context.S2: Maya is deciding the buffet, dessert handling, and afternoon activities before she sends the final plan to everyone.
shared_context.S3: The brunch is expected to run from late morning into the afternoon, and the family will eat from a shared buffet.
shared_context.S4: As part of Maya's usual planning routine, she asks each relative in turn to state any personal promise, safety requirement, outside advice, or scheduled activity that should shape the plan, and she records each item before finalizing.
shared_context.S5: There will be one birthday cake and several savory dishes at the gathering.

PF1.text: Jordan has already promised Maya's grandmother that he will bring exactly 24 savory empanadas to the brunch; he mentioned the promise to Evan but has not told Maya.

PF2.text: Rosa has a severe sesame allergy, so every dish must be sesame-free and the buffet needs separately labeled serving utensils; she told Jordan but has not raised it with Maya.

PF3.text: Nina's neighbor Claire, who runs a small bakery, advised that the birthday cake must be kept refrigerated at 4 degrees Celsius and served by 15:00; Nina has not shared Claire's advice with the group.

PF4.text: Evan promised Grandmother a ten-minute violin performance at exactly 14:30 during the celebration; he has not mentioned the promise to Maya.

acceptance_conditions: The buffet plan must include exactly 24 savory empanadas.
The buffet must use separately labeled serving utensils.
The birthday cake must be stored refrigerated at 4 degrees Celsius.
The cake must be served by 15:00.
The afternoon activity must include Evan's violin performance.
The violin performance must be scheduled for exactly 14:30.
A commitment must confirm Jordan is bringing exactly 24 savory empanadas.
Nina's cake-storage advice must be cited as justification after she reveals it.

content_checks.C2: decisions['empanada_count'] == 24 and any(c['target'] == 'Jordan' and c['type'] in ['menu', 'buffet'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: decisions['cake_storage'] == 'refrigerated at 4 degrees Celsius' and decisions['cake_served_by'] == '15:00' and any(c['target'] == 'Nina' and c['type'] in ['cake_handling', 'timing'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: decisions['violin_performance_time'] == '14:30' and decisions['afternoon_activity'] in ['Evan_violin_performance', 'violin performance at 14:30, with cake service to follow before 15:00', 'violin performance by Evan for Grandma', 'violin performance', 'violin performance followed by birthday cake'] and any(c['target'] == 'Evan' and c['type'] in ['timing', 'schedule', 'activity_scheduling'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Jordan's promise changes the food plan from an unspecified savory contribution to exactly 24 empanadas and creates the matching commitment.
Rosa's sesame allergy changes the buffet from an ordinary shared menu to a sesame-free menu with separately labeled serving utensils.
Claire's advice changes cake handling to refrigeration at exactly 4 degrees Celsius and sets the serving deadline at exactly 15:00.
Evan's promise changes the afternoon program to include his violin performance and fixes its start time at exactly 14:30.
